title: Ankita EP06 — Three Separate Pair Lanes, Honest Expertise, Weekly Rhythm, Accidental Beats
authorPrinciples: Karan and Aman share Ankita/Kabir's household; daily casual contact and short flexible doubts need no artificial appointment.
Technical sessions for Vivan/Reyansh/Sana may occur after office, office overtime, or by coordinated home visit with a legitimate learning goal; not a daily tutoring fiction.
Aishwarya is HR/event coordination, NOT a Java learner in the technical group. Her independent Karan mentorship is optional, tied to her recruiting/career expertise, with mutual agreement.
Ayaan–Armaan are a separate society/JAM learning pair, not presumed confirmed biological twins or immediate flirtation leads.
Do not publish newly imagined accidental garment incidents as already happened. Distinguish confirmed past contact from future proposed visual milestones.
Ankita's own comfort, work/private boundaries and choice remain consistent; friendly attraction does not mean automatic permission for touching.

firstAccidentalSlipProposal.candidate: Saturday 3 Jan after push-up game in society gym/common exercise corner
firstAccidentalSlipProposal.mechanism: Ankita reaches for a rolled mat or bag. A loose outer athletic layer catches briefly on its strap and slips slightly across one shoulder, showing the upper-back line and sport top beneath. She adjusts the outfit herself immediately; do not invent exposure of intimate areas or physical assistance.
reactionOrder: Aman first notices and warns politely, informed by the earlier scooty boundary.
Karan makes one reflexive joke, pauses when she looks at him and pivots back to the push-up result.
Ankita knowingly fixes the strap, responds with a confident challenge, and is aware each brother reacted differently.
firstAccidentalSlipProposal.novelty: First *garment shift* with these two; NOT first accidental proximity, touch, or chemistry.
firstAccidentalSlipProposal.knowledge: Ankita knows exactly what slipped. Neither twin acquires permission to touch or to use the incident against her.
